paper_title: Leveraging ChatGPT As Text Annotation Tool For Sentiment Analysis
caption: Accuracy of ChatGPT VS VADER and TextBlob
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates accuracy values for three sentiment analysis/annotation tools (TextBlob, VADER, and ChatGPT) across two tweet sets. The horizontal axis contains the two categories, ordered left to right as “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet,” and the axis is labeled “Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis.” The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “Accuracy,” shown on a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.8 with regularly spaced tick marks at approximately 0.2 intervals. Each category contains a grouped set of three side-by-side bars: a plain white bar with a black outline for TEXTBLOB, a white bar with diagonal hatching for VADER, and a solid green bar for ChatGPT, as indicated by the legend positioned on the right side of the plotting area. For “Emoji Tweets,” the TextBlob bar reaches roughly 0.33, the VADER bar reaches about 0.45, and the ChatGPT bar reaches approximately 0.67. For “Overall Tweet,” the TextBlob bar is near 0.40, the VADER bar is around 0.47, and the ChatGPT bar is roughly 0.66. The bars are not presented as sorted by value; they follow the fixed category order on the x-axis and a consistent tool order within each group, with no additional visual emphasis (such as annotations or outlines beyond the standard bar borders).
